<thought>Based on the NMR data the molecule contains a carbonyl (167 ppm) attached to nitrogen, an alkene (143.85 ppm and 130.30 ppm) and several aliphatic methyl groups. The logical way to split the structure into joinable pieces is: an amide carbonyl fragment, an alkene fragment, and the remaining alkyl (methyl) fragments. Their SMILES representations are:

- amide carbonyl fragment: C(=O)N  
- alkene fragment: C=C  
- methyl fragment: C  

These fragments can be linked together to reconstruct the C₈H₁₄NO molecule.</thought>
<final_answer>['C(=O)N', 'C=C', 'C']</final_answer>
